## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      4 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jun 5, 2026 - Jul 29, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Ryanangellll_, Jul 29, 2026, 1/5: "There is a major optimization bug causing the app to freeze instantly on launch. Even a fresh install fails after a few minutes of use. Standard troubleshooting like wiping app data and fresh reinstalls do not fix the issue permanently. It is a recurring system conflict that needs a developer patch."
            2. _lpdot_, Jul 28, 2026, 1/5: "It seems the last update completely broke the app. The UI is stuck, menus and buttons don't work, query input field is frozen. Update: uninstalled the app, installed again. Worked for a day, now broken again. Pathetic."
            3. _RealFeedback147_, Jul 27, 2026, 1/5: "1 Star I paid for Gemini because it worked really well at first, but over the last few weeks it’s become increasingly unreliable. Many of my chats now glitch, stop responding, and just sit there with the loading wheel spinning forever without ever generating a reply. I’ve reported the issue several times, but I’ve never received a response from support. To make matters worse, I can’t even find a live chat option to speak to someone. For a paid service, that’s simply not acceptable. The AI is good when it actually works, but the constant glitches and lack of customer support have completely ruined the experience. Until Google fixes these issues and provides proper support for paying customers, I can’t recommend paying for Gemini."
